title: EQUATE : A Benchmark Evaluation Framework for Quantitative Reasoning in Natural Language Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Perturbing quantities in entailed premise-hypothesis pairs to create contradictions, evaluating whether models inappropriately rely on verbal/lexical overlap cues instead of performing actual numerical reasoning.

Using a FastText classifier trained solely on the hypothesis text (ignoring the premise) to evaluate if models can guess the correct entailment label based on dataset artifacts and spurious correlations.
